thread:
maya: nightly eval alert — legal-qa prompt set showing a ~9.8% failure increase on ceres-6b-q4f in last run, regressed compared to yesterday. failing items mostly short-context Q/A (<50 tokens). report: https://ci.internal/nightly/197650

infra-bot: deploy succeeded: canary -> fused-attn: reorder-loop-optim (commit b7c1d2f) at 1976504000

ren: ugh that timing lines up with the canary. any smoke logs?

sanjay: grabbing samples now. initial look: output truncation + odd insertions when prefix is reused across requests. looks like KV cache indexing off-by-one in the fused path?

maya: sample pair (prompt, model output) below. old runtime vs new fused-attn runtime. note short prompt length (34 tokens).

maya: ```
prompt: "Q: What is the statute of limitations for contract disputes in CA?
A:"
old-runtime: "A: In California, the statute of limitations for most written contracts is four years; for oral contracts it's two years."
new-runtime: "A: In California, the statute of limitations for most written contracts is four years. The court may also consider equitable estoppel. The statute of limitations for fraud claims is three years."
```

maya: new output introduces unrelated clause and sometimes repeats fragments across requests. not just wording changes — added hallucinated legal clause.

eva: ran quick AB with seed=42 and prefix-reuse script (same session, reuse kv cache). disabling fused-attn (env RUNNER_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1) drops failure back to baseline.

eva: repro command: ```
export MODEL=ceres-6b-q4f
export SEED=42
# repro uses the harness prefix_reuse.py which sends same prefix twice in one session
RUNNER_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=0 python infra/tests/prefix_reuse.py --model $MODEL --seed $SEED
# toggle to confirm
RUNNER_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1 python infra/tests/prefix_reuse.py --model $MODEL --seed $SEED
```

sanjay: i also dumped KV indices and attention offsets. quick diff: when fused path enabled, the KV write ptr for layer 6 is incremented one step earlier during the second request leading to misaligned keys. artifact only seen when request reuses cached prefix (i.e., session continuation) and when seq_len < 64.

ren: do we have a minimal reproducer that runs locally without full infra? can we create a unit test?

sanjay: yes — pushed a small test to my branch: tests/runtime/test_prefix_kv_alignment.py. it creates two short requests that reuse prefix and asserts identical top-k logits between fused and non-fused paths. failing CI shows KL=0.127 for short prompts, KL<0.01 expected.

maya: thanks. plan suggestion: hotfix to temporarily revert fused reorder in canary -> patch PR to revert b7c1d2f and add the unit test + nightly regression check for prefix-reuse scenarios. then deeper root cause: ensure fused attention maintains identical KV write timing to unfused kernel.

eva: agree. also add an eval in nightly harness that includes short-context prefix-reuse prompts with deterministic seeds and compare token distributions (KL/thresh). that's cheap and should catch this class of regressions early.

ren: who can own the canary revert? sanjay?

sanjay: i'll open the revert PR now and include the failing test. will also attach my KV dump logs: s3://redwood-debug/197650_kv_dumps.tar.gz

maya: assign to eng-runtime on the revert, add a postmortem note in incidents if revert is promoted to prod. thanks team. :thumbsup:

ren: quick follow-up: add a note to the rollout checklist to run prefix-reuse eval after fused-attn changes. I'll update the playbook.

infra-bot: PR #4329 created by sanjay: revert fused-attn reorder (b7c1d2f). status: draft.

maya: ack. we'll monitor next nightly.

eva: small reminder: test also flagged subtle probs for sampling when top-k filtering combined with fused kernels. adding that to the test matrix now.

ren: cool, keep updates here.

sanjay: updating thread with PR link + CI logs in 15m.
